name: Validate TUI Sidebar Component Values
description: Comprehensive validation that TUI sidebar components display accurate values from API endpoints. Tests impulse-activity-map, activity-acp-map, integration-graph, and cost-breakdown endpoints with real data and verifies rendering logic.

task_steps.description: Run TUI sidebar unit tests to verify rendering logic

prompt.template:
Run the TUI sidebar Phase 2 unit tests to verify all rendering logic is correct:

1. Execute: bun test repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/test/cli/tui-sidebar-phase2.test.ts --verbose
2. Verify all 59 tests pass
3. Report any failures with test names and error messages
4. Check that all critical value display tests pass:
   - Impulse utilization calculations
   - Token budget tracking
   - ACP agent cost formatting
   - Tree structure rendering
   - Edge weight calculations

Provide a summary of test results with focus on data accuracy.

task_steps.description: Verify sidebar data endpoints are correctly implemented in server

prompt.template:
Verify the server implements all required sidebar data endpoints correctly:

1. Search for endpoint implementations in repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/server/server.ts:
   - /session/:id/relationships/impulse-activity-map
   - /session/:id/relationships/activity-acp-map
   - /session/:id/relationships/integration-graph
   - /session/:id/relationships/cost-breakdown
   - /session/:id/state

2. For each endpoint, verify:
   - Route is registered
   - Proper HTTP method (GET)
   - Response schema is defined
   - Error handling (404, 400, 500)
   - Description/documentation

3. Check that SessionState types are properly defined:
   - ImpulseActivityMapResponse
   - ActivityACPMapResponse
   - IntegrationGraphResponse
   - CostBreakdownResponse

Report which endpoints are properly implemented and any gaps.

task_steps.description: Verify data accuracy calculations in sidebar component

prompt.template:
Validate the accuracy of data calculations in the sidebar component (repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/cli/cmd/tui/routes/session/sidebar.tsx):

1. Review calculation functions:
   - formatProgressBar(percentage, width): verify bar rendering is accurate
   - formatElapsedTime(ms): verify time formatting handles all cases
   - getUtilizationStatus(percent): verify thresholds and emoji assignments
   - getUtilizationColor(percent): verify color mapping to thresholds

2. For impulse display (renderImpulseRelationships):
   - Verify token utilization calculation: (usedTokens / budget) * 100
   - Check that 80% threshold for warning colors is applied correctly
   - Verify load count display format

3. For ACP agent display (renderACPSource):
   - Verify status-to-color mapping
   - Check cost formatting: ${cost.toFixed(2)}
   - Verify activity title or ID fallback

4. For flow diagram (renderFlowDiagram):
   - Verify tree structure prefixes are correct (├─, └─)
   - Check edge filtering logic
   - Verify stats aggregation

Report if any calculations have accuracy issues or edge case problems.

task_steps.description: Create integration test with mock session data

prompt.template:
Create a comprehensive integration test for the sidebar component that validates it displays accurate values:

1. Create file: repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/test/cli/tui-sidebar-integration.test.ts

2. Write tests that:
   - Mock a complete session state with real-looking data
   - Mock impulse-activity-map endpoint responses
   - Mock activity-acp-map endpoint responses  
   - Mock integration-graph endpoint responses
   - Mock cost-breakdown endpoint responses
   - Render the sidebar component
   - Verify displayed values match source data

3. Test specific accuracy scenarios:
   - Impulse with 95% utilization displays warning
   - Total cost calculation across all impulses
   - ACP agent cost aggregation
   - Graph node and edge counts match stats
   - Budget utilization percentage is correct

4. Run tests: bun test repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/test/cli/tui-sidebar-integration.test.ts

Report test results and any accuracy issues found.

task_steps.description: Final validation report on sidebar value accuracy

prompt.template:
Provide a final comprehensive validation report on TUI sidebar component value accuracy:

1. Summary of all tests run and their results
2. Verification that all required endpoints are implemented
3. Confirmation of data calculation accuracy
4. List of any issues found and their severity
5. Specific values that were validated as accurate:
   - Impulse token utilization percentages
   - Cost calculations and formatting
   - ACP agent status colors
   - Time and progress bar formatting
   - Graph structure and statistics

6. Recommendations for any improvements

Format as:
✅ VALIDATED: [list of accurate components]
⚠️  WARNINGS: [any non-critical issues]
❌ FAILURES: [any critical issues found]

Conclusion: Are sidebar values accurate? YES/NO
